text:
Vera N: Hey folks, spontaneous "Console Couch Royale" tonight in the lounge? Thinking Smash (free-for-all), a chill Rocket League round, and a tucked-away Indie corner on the Steam Deck. Bring controllers and snacks.

Sam K: I'm in. I can bring a couple of controllers and a tiny travel router if we need to isolate the Remote Play traffic.

Jon P: I have a wireless stick that pairs weirdly. I'll bring my wired PS4 pad instead. Also can bring a small surge protector.

Hana L: Count me. Bringing an HDMI capture (USB3) and a tripod if anyone wants a goofy overhead of the couch chaos.

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Start" "6:30pm" "7:30pm" "8:00pm"

partybot: Poll created: "Start" — 6:30pm (3), 7:30pm (1).

Vera N: 6:30 works. Logistics: lounge outlet by the plants is flaky, bring an extension + gaffer tape. Also someone bring an ethernet cable for the travel router so Remote Play doesn't die.

Sam K: I'll bring a 5m Cat6 and the router. Quick setup tip: create an SSID like redwood-arcade and password on the router so remote players can join one dedicated network.

Jon P: Anyone up for a silly rule: losers buy the next round of snacks? :moneybag:

Hana L: I'm good with recording highlights. I'll clip 15s bits and post them. If you don't want to be on camera, ping me before your match.

Vera N: Also, if anyone has a GameCube memory card or a Smash GC adapter, please bring it  we might do some Melee mayhem.

Sam K: I have the GC adapter and a couple of GameCube pads. Will bring both.

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Games" "Smash" "Rocket League" "Jackbox" "Indie co-op"

partybot: Poll created: "Games" — Smash (4), Rocket League (2), Jackbox (1), Indie co-op (1).

Vera N: Smash top, nice. Quick network note for remote entrants: if you're using Parsec, prefer UDP mode and lower resolution if your bandwidth is <5mbit. For Steam Remote Play, switch to low-latency mode in client settings.

Jon P: Also FYI if you bring Bluetooth controllers, pair them before you get here  Bluetooth on the lounge AP is funky.

Hana L: Snack run? I can pick up chips + a vegan dip if people chip in.

Vera N: I'll Venmo $5. @Maya (events) can you post the lounge code and a quick RSVP?

Maya (events): Posted event + entry code in #events. Reminder: bring jackets; it's breezy near the lounge balcony after sunset.

Sam K: I'll power the travel router and set NAT to 'open' so Parsec plays nicer. If anyone needs the command to enable IP forwarding on a linux host: `sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1`

Jon P: Bring labels for controllers so they don't walk off. Also please tidy cables with the ties in the storage closet.

Hana L: Recording confirmed; I'll drop a 20s montage in #random after.

Vera N: Sweet. See y'all at 6:30! :video_game: :popcorn:
